create_HabitatSim_simulator: create a HabitatSim simulator instance from a SimulatorConfig to run embodied AI simulation
use_HabitatSimRGBSensor: build an RGB sensor for the HabitatSim simulator that returns 3-channel color observations
use_HabitatSimDepthSensor: build a depth sensor for the HabitatSim simulator with optional normalization and clipping
use_HabitatSimSemanticSensor: build a semantic segmentation sensor for the HabitatSim simulator returning uint32 object IDs
call_overwrite_config: overwrite a Habitat-Sim config object with Habitat Lab config values using case-insensitive matching
